summary_en: ¥167/share year-end dividend for FY2026 (¥93 ordinary + ¥74 special), vs. ¥93 prior forecast. Payout ratio 65.2%. Special dividend reflects tax gain from subsidiary liquidation. Policy targets payout ratio ≥65% or DOE ≥10%, whichever higher.
title_en: Notice regarding recognition of corporate tax adjustment gain, revision of full-year consolidated business forecasts for FY2026, and revision of year-end dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: GMO Pepabo announced on 13 August 2026 a revision to its FY2026 dividend forecast and full-year earnings guidance. The revision follows recognition of a deferred tax asset (tax gain) stemming from the liquidation of consolidated subsidiary CN Corp., which the company resolved to wind down in June 2026. As a result of the tax gain, parent company net income for FY2026 is now estimated at ¥1,322 million, up 79.9% from the prior forecast of ¥735 million. The company has raised its year-end dividend forecast to ¥167 per share (¥93 ordinary + ¥74 special), compared with the prior forecast of ¥93 per share. The higher payout reflects the company's stated dividend policy of targeting either a payout ratio of 65% or above or a DOE of 10% or above, whichever is higher. The revised FY2026 dividend results in a payout ratio of 65.2%.
